examCheckpoints.label: ★ Race exam: share of checkpoints reached

examFinished.label: ★ Race exam: share of races finished

heldOutSuccess.label: ★ Held-out (fixed scenarios, hardest level): share of targets reached

exam.label: Race exam score: 1000 per missed checkpoint + seconds + distance left (lower is better; sums over races, compare equal exam sizes only)

heldOut.label: Held-out score (fixed scenarios, hardest level; lower is better)

success.label: Training: share of targets the winner reached (this generation's scenarios and level)

score.label: Training: winner's score (scenarios change every generation; not a progress measure)

mean.label: Training: mean score of the generation

worst.label: Training: worst score of the generation

reevalScore.label: Re-evaluation: winner's score on the extra scenarios

reevalSuccess.label: Re-evaluation: winner's share of targets on the extra scenarios

examRobust.label: Robustness exam score (input delay and noise; lower is better)

examRobustCheckpoints.label: Robustness exam: share of checkpoints reached

examRobustFinished.label: Robustness exam: share of races finished

sigma.label: Mutation σ (scheduled, or the winner's self-adaptive σ)

tps.label: Speed: game ticks per second (timing only, not a result)

ticks.label: Speed: game ticks simulated in the generation (timing only)

shipStepsPerSec.label: Speed: ship-steps per second (moving ships × frames; the real simulation work; timing only)

shipSteps.label: Speed: ship-steps simulated in the generation (timing only)
